biography.ja: ハンガリーのケストヘイに生まれ、ウィーンで学んだが、正規の音楽教育はごく限られており、実質的にはほぼ独学で作曲を身につけた。40代で書いた聖書のエピソードに基づくオペラが空前の成功を収め、一躍名声を確立した。門下には後にフィンランドを代表する作曲家となるシベリウスがいる。
biography.en: Born in Keszthely, Hungary, and trained in Vienna, he received only limited formal instruction and was, in practical terms, largely self-taught as a composer. An opera he wrote in his forties, based on a biblical episode, was an unprecedented success and established his fame at a stroke. His pupils included Sibelius, who would go on to become Finland's leading composer.

style.ja: ワーグナー流の濃密な和声語法と、東洋的・異国風の旋律の色彩を組み合わせた作風を特徴とし、代表的なオペラでは聖書の物語を華麗な音響で描いた。独学ゆえの型にはまらない自由な発想と、当時最先端であったワーグナーの語法への強い関心が同居する点に独自性がある。
style.en: His style combines dense Wagnerian harmony with an exotic, Orientalist coloring of melody, and his best-known opera depicts a biblical story in richly sonorous music. His distinctiveness lies in the coexistence of an unconventional freedom born of self-teaching with a strong interest in the Wagnerian idiom that was cutting-edge in his day.

impact.ja: 生前は代表作のオペラが繰り返し上演される大ヒット作となり、ウィーン楽壇で確固たる地位を築いたが、没後は次第に上演機会が減り、今日ではヴァイオリン協奏曲など一部の作品のみが知られる。教育者としてはシベリウスを短期間指導しており、独学の作曲家が北欧を代表する若き才能の学びの一端を担ったという点で興味深い接点を残した。
impact.en: In his lifetime his signature opera became a repeatedly staged hit that secured him a firm place in Viennese musical life, but performances gradually declined after his death, and today only a handful of works, such as a violin concerto, remain widely known. As a teacher he briefly guided Sibelius, leaving an intriguing point of contact in which a largely self-taught composer played a part in shaping a young talent who would come to represent Nordic music.

ja: 独学で身につけた作曲技法
聖書物語に基づく大ヒットオペラ
シベリウスを短期間指導
en: Hit opera on a biblical story
